PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2 OF 2009
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2
OF 2009
SUPREME COURT JUDGES
(LEAVE, PENSION AND
PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2009
An Order further to
amend the Supreme Court
Judges (Leave, Pension
and Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
10th January, 2009]
No.F.2(2)/2009-Pub.,
dated 10-1-2009.--The following President's Order promulgated by the President
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend
the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997, (P.O.
No.2 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by the Fifth schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan the President is pleased to make the following Order:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) The Order may be called the Supreme Court Judges
(Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force with
immediate effect.
